resources.string: Tap groups of 3 or more blocks to explode them.

Clear Color
%1$s cleared
Explode %1$d block groups
Explode matching groups
In BoomBlocks, you don\'t launch or drag pieces. Instead, look for three or more touching blocks of the same color and tap any of them to clear the whole group.
Dynamic board movement
When a group explodes, it creates a vacuum that pulls surrounding blocks in. New blocks then refill the board from the nearest edge, keeping the action dynamic.
You are ready for BoomBlocks
Focus on finding large groups for maximum score and watch how each explosion reshapes the board. Good luck!
Tap to explode
Find a group of three or more same-colored blocks and tap them to clear them from the board.
Bigger groups, more points
Larger groups give more points and clear more space. Tap the highlighted large group!
Gravity shifts
When you explode blocks, new ones fall in from the opposite side of the explosion. Watch how the board shifts!
Strategic refills
New blocks refill the board based on the explosion center. Use this to set up even bigger groups!
Tap the highlighted group to continue.
